decisions.reason: The area elastic sports flooring system builds directly on the firm's wood-surface and production know-how, so the firm can read early results and refine it with its own R&D.
The mobile arena floor extends the firm's existing sports flooring expertise, and in-house technical service lets it absorb customer feedback and improve the system.
This second mobile arena system overlaps with B, so consolidation is a risk, but it still rests on related knowledge the firm can use.
The chevron parquet is a flagship that sits at the core of the firm's trend-led premium flooring knowledge and its strategic direction.
The squash court finish is a niche product, but it draws on the firm's surface-treatment competence and costs little to keep in the sports range.
The oak skirting is a simple accessory that uses existing oak processing skills and supports sales of the sports floor systems.
